_about: Synthetic recording of the verification of p-payment-app-debug-drop (`make fixtures-synth`, server/server/verify_synth.py): Grail answers for the volume and reference queries and the Dynatrace MCP execute_dql answer for new Davis problems. The MCP result format is not documented; this uses a JSON text block. Replace with real recordings once a tenant exists.

volume.query:
fetch logs, from: -60m
| filter service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG"
| summarize before = countIf(timestamp < now() - 30m),
    after = countIf(timestamp >= now() - 30m)

alert:Payment failures.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "payment" and loglevel == "ERROR"
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), interval: 1m

problems.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from: -30m
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter event.start >= now() - 30m
| fields display_id, event.name, event.status, event.category, event.start
